scope: Operator injection into document-store queries, such as MongoDB operators in JSON or bracket parameters.
exclusions: SQL syntax belongs to sqli_classic or sqli_obfuscated
Operator keys accepted by a documented filter API
required_evidence: Structured JSON or bracket-syntax parameter with operator keys
Known document-store backend or filter endpoint context
Raw body preserved with parser type
benign_counterexamples: Admin search API documented to accept dollar-prefixed operators
Analytics payload with a dollar-sign field in a price label
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
